articles.image_title: »Versöhnungsmarsch«: BRNO, CZECH REPUBLIC - MAY 22: Members of the Böhmerlandtanzgruppe from Brazil prepare to perform at the Sudetendeutsche Landsmannsschaft, which represents the descendants of ethnic Germans expelled from Czechoslovakia in 1945-1946, long table event during their annual gathering on May 22, 2026 in Brno, Czech Republic. The Sudeten German conference is taking place for the first time in the Czech Republic and has sparked controversy and local protests. In 1945 and 1946 Czechoslovak authorities, who accused Sudeten Germans of having supported the brutal Nazi occupation of Bohemia and Moravia, expelled approximately three million ethnic Germans and confiscated their property following the end of World War II. articles.image_title: Gaza: GAZA CITY, GAZA - MAY 26: Emergency teams arrived at the scene following Israeli airstrikes on a residential building in the Rimal area of ​​Gaza City on May 26, 2026 in Gaza City, Gaza. According to a joint statement from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz, a strike carried out on a residential building in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City on Tuesday targeted the new Hamas military chief, Mohammed Odeh. Initial reports have said at least two were killed in the strike and 10 injured, but it was unclear if Odeh was among the casualties. Odeh was reportedly appointed to replace Izz al-Din al-Haddad, who was assassinated in an IDF strike on May 15. (Photo by Ahmad Hasaballah/Getty Images)
